fields.value: LEFT=left, RIGHT=right, UP=drop, DOWN=down, A=left, B=right, C=rotate, D=down, KEY0=left, KEY1=right, BOOT=rotate, REFRESH=down, OK=rotate, ENTER=rotate, SELECT=hold, primary=rotate, next=right, prev=left, up=drop, down=down, back=hold, menu=pause, refresh=down
fields.description: The frame's GPIO buttons, by label (or role): left, right, down, drop, rotate, rotateback, hold, pause. On e-paper, LEFT and RIGHT pressed together turn the piece and a double press of down drops it.

blockDrop.name: Block drop
blockDrop.description: A falling-block puzzle in the 8-bit palette mode: seven shapes of four cells, a well ten by twenty, turns with wall kicks, a ghost, previews and a keep slot. Touch, keys and GPIO buttons; one move a press on e-paper.
